name: Quick actions
purpose: A configurable row/grid of shortcut buttons giving fast access to common tasks. Each item is an icon or avatar with a short label; items can be reordered via a drag handle.

accessibility.label: Each action needs an accessible name (the visible label); icon/avatar alone is insufficient
accessibility.pressed: Pressed state flips to a dark surface with reverse text/icon — ensure contrast holds; expose pressed/selected to AT
accessibility.reorder: Drag-to-reorder must have a keyboard/AT-accessible alternative (move up/down) and announce the new position

antiPatterns: Icon-only quick actions without a label / accessible name
Drag-only reordering with no keyboard alternative
Leaving the item surfaces/borders on the deprecated tokens — migrate to background/default + tertiary/background/pressed + divider/border/subsection (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: DEPRECATED — same surface set as List items / Navigations; all clean rebinds except the neutral-1 chip tint (no live equivalent).

blockersNoEquivalent.rebind: REVIEW — no live subtle-surface (Avatar/Headers/List/Nav gap family)

depricateUsage.note: Identical pattern to List items (Item/Badge rows) and Navigations: surface/primary/* → background/default | tertiary/background/*; on-dark/pressed → reverse; neutral-1 tint = the recurring no-equivalent subtle-surface blocker. See $interactive_namespace_note.
